name: SDR lead agent
oneLiner: Turns every reply and engagement signal into one decision for the SDR: call now, triangulate, auto-reply or watch.
problem: Campaigns and events bring in replies faster than a small sales team can work them. The signals that say who to call sit in different tools, and by the time someone reads them, the interest has gone cold.
problemExcerpt: faster than a small sales team
built: Two n8n workflows that find US retail accounts running Anaplan from public signals (its customer page, LinkedIn job posts) and verify each one live in Apollo.
Contact mapping in Hunter: economic buyer, champion, power user and influencer for each account.
A 24-node lead agent: ownership gate, an LLM that sorts free text into six outcomes, fit and intent scores, four lanes under a capacity cap, and a brief for the SDR.
A four-touch sequence built around the contract renewal window, co-designed with the BDRs.
A third proposal, Boomerang, with its kill rule written before the first line of code.
proof: In a burst of 8 replies, 2 went to the SDR and 6 were routed with their reason
Presented in the final round at Pigment
